describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing lateral view standing on a flat light surface. It has a low, stout, quadrupedal body with a broad flat head at the front and a thick tapering tail at the rear. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the base of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown keratinous scales, while the ventral surface, sides of the head, limbs, and tail are pale pink with wrinkled, fleshy skin. The head is wide and blunt-snouted with small golden eyes, small nostrils, and a wide mouth, and bears prominent pink feathery external gills on both sides of the neck. The four limbs are thick and splayed slightly outward, each ending in a five-toed foot with small claws.

describe.description: A stout, low-slung four-legged creature shown in side three-quarter view facing to the right. It has a broad, flat, rounded-snout amphibian-like head that is mottled brown-pink with large golden eyes, small nostrils, and a wide mouth line, with multiple pink feathery external gill stalks protruding from the neck just behind the head on both sides. The underbody, neck, and short thick limbs are pale pink with wrinkled, moist-looking skin. The entire back from behind the gills to the base of the tail is covered in overlapping large brown keratin-like scales. The animal stands on four short sturdy legs ending in broad clawed toes, and a long smooth pale pink tapering tail extends to the left from the rear of the body.
